title: Site-wide words
description: Buttons, labels and small bits of text used across the site. Leave a field empty to use the original wording. Words in {curly brackets} are filled in automatically, so keep them as they are.

ctaTailoring.title: Book tailoring (while bridal is on the waitlist)
ctaTailoring.description: The main button across the site while bridal is on the waitlist: the home page, the menu, the sticky button and the end of each service.

ctaWaitlistYear.title: Join the bridal waitlist (with the year)
ctaWaitlistYear.description: The second button while bridal is on the waitlist. {year} becomes the year from the reopening time in Site Settings, such as "2027".

ctaWaitlist.title: Join the bridal waitlist (no year known)
ctaWaitlist.description: Used instead of the one above when the reopening time in Site Settings has no year in it.

ctaConsult.title: Book a consultation (everything open)
ctaConsult.description: The main button across the site when every service is open.

ctaServices.title: View services (everything open)
ctaServices.description: The second button on the home page when every service is open.

ctaParty.title: Send a bridal party request
ctaParty.description: Under "Bridal party & mother of the bride" on the services page, and the sticky button on the bridal party page while bridal is on the waitlist.

ctaTailoringOpen.title: Small link on bridal pages: tailoring is open
ctaTailoringOpen.description: On phones, the small link under the sticky waitlist button on the wedding dress guides and the David's Bridal page, while bridal is on the waitlist.
ctaTailoringOpen.default: Tailoring and repairs are open now

ctaOr.title: Small link under the sticky button: the other choice
ctaOr.description: On phones, the small link under the sticky button while bridal is on the waitlist. {action} becomes the waitlist button's words starting with a small letter, such as "join the 2027 bridal waitlist".

bannerHeadlineYear.title: Headline (with the year)
bannerHeadlineYear.description: The dark banner at the bottom of the home, services, portfolio and about pages, while bridal is on the waitlist. (When everything is open, the banner uses each page's own wording.) {year} becomes the reopening year, such as "2027".

bannerHeadline.title: Headline (no year known)
bannerHeadline.description: Used instead of the one above when the reopening time in Site Settings has no year in it.

bannerSubhead.title: Line under the headline
bannerSubhead.description: {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings, such as "early 2027".
bannerSubhead.default: Bridal fittings reopen {reopens}. Waitlist brides get first choice of fitting dates, in the order they joined.

navServices.title: Menu: Services
navServices.description: In the header, the phone menu, the footer links and the page-not-found links.

navGuides.title: Menu: Guides
navGuides.description: Shown once at least one guide is published.

navMenuFooter.title: Phone menu: line at the bottom
navMenuFooter.description: The small line at the bottom of the open menu on phones.

navHomeLabel.title: Read aloud: your name in the header
navHomeLabel.description: What screen readers say for your name at the top left, which goes to the home page. {business} becomes the business name from Site Settings.

navOpenMenu.title: Read aloud: open the phone menu

navCloseMenu.title: Read aloud: close the phone menu

navMenuLabel.title: Read aloud: the open phone menu

navMobileLabel.title: Read aloud: the links in the phone menu

navSkip.title: Skip link
navSkip.description: Appears only for people using a keyboard: the first thing they reach on every page, to jump past the header.

footerStudioLine.title: Studio column: where
footerStudioLine.description: {location} becomes the location from Site Settings. Your availability line from Site Settings shows below it.

footerSendRequest.title: Contact column: link to the contact form

footerElsewhereHeading.title: Last column: heading (no policies yet)
footerElsewhereHeading.description: Used until the Policies page is published.

footerReview.title: Link to leave a Google review
footerReview.description: Shown when a Google review link is set in Site Settings.

footerCopyright.title: Copyright line
footerCopyright.description: {year} becomes this year and {business} the business name from Site Settings.

footerNavLabel.title: Read aloud: the footer links
footerNavLabel.description: The links themselves use the Menu words under "Header and menu".

homeEyebrow.title: Small line above the headline
homeEyebrow.description: The small capitals above your big headline at the top of the home page. (The "Hero: Section Label" on the Home Page document is not shown on the site; this is.)

homeIntro.title: Line under the headline
homeIntro.description: The sentence between the headline and the buttons. (The "Hero: Credential Body Text" on the Home Page document is not shown on the site; this is.)
homeIntro.default: A formally trained designer and former Lead Alterations Specialist at David’s Bridal, fitting one client at a time.

homeScroll.title: "Scroll" hint
homeScroll.description: The tiny word at the bottom of the first screen on a computer.

homeHeroAlt.title: Portrait description
homeHeroAlt.description: Read by screen readers only when the portrait on the Home Page document has no alt text of its own. {name} becomes your name from Site Settings.

homeStatsRegion.title: Read aloud: the row of numbers

pillTailoring.title: Availability badge: tailoring line
pillTailoring.description: The small bordered badge above the headline while bridal is on the waitlist. (When everything is open it shows the booking note from Site Settings.)

pillBridal.title: Availability badge: bridal line
pillBridal.description: {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings, such as "early 2027".

homeWaitlistTag.title: Service card: waitlist tag
homeWaitlistTag.description: Above the title of a service card that is on the waitlist. {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings.

homeTailoringLine.title: Service card: tailoring description
homeTailoringLine.description: The tailoring card uses this line instead of the service's short description.
homeTailoringLine.default: Hems, waists, sleeves and zips, done cleanly, usually within two weeks.

homeCardWaitlistFor.title: Read aloud after the waitlist link
homeCardWaitlistFor.description: Screen readers hear this straight after the link, so it says which service. {service} becomes the service name.

homeCardMoreAbout.title: Read aloud after the learn more link

homeViewAll.title: Portfolio preview: link beside the heading

homeViewPortfolio.title: Portfolio preview: button under the photos

homeAboutText.title: About teaser: paragraph
homeAboutText.description: Under the pull quote in the pink About section.
homeAboutText.default: I trained as a designer at IUP and spent a year as Lead Alterations Specialist at David’s Bridal. Now I work for myself, one client at a time, out of a studio in Pittsburgh. Every quote is itemized in writing before I cut a thread.

reviewsMarried.title: Reviews: wedding month
reviewsMarried.description: In the line under each review. {month} becomes the month from the testimonial, such as "August 2024".

reviewsVia.title: Reviews: where it was posted
reviewsVia.description: The small tag under a review that came from somewhere else. {source} becomes the source, such as "Google".

reviewsSlide.title: Read aloud: which review is showing
reviewsSlide.description: {number} becomes the review's position and {total} how many there are.

reviewsDot.title: Read aloud: the dots under the reviews

instaHeading.title: Instagram row: heading
instaHeading.description: Above the row of Instagram photos, shown once photos are added in Site Settings.

instaAlt.title: Instagram row: photo description
instaAlt.description: Read by screen readers when an Instagram photo has no alt text of its own.

servicesHeading.title: Page headline
servicesHeading.description: The big headline at the top of the services page. (The "Hero Heading" on the Services Page document is not shown on the site; this is.)

servicesWaitlistNote.title: Waitlist box: note
servicesWaitlistNote.description: The bordered box at the top of a service that is on the waitlist. {service} becomes the service name and {reopens} the reopening time from Site Settings.
servicesWaitlistNote.default: {service} booking reopens {reopens}. I'm taking a limited waitlist now and will reach out in order as dates open.

servicesWaitlistLink.title: Waitlist box: link
servicesWaitlistLink.description: {first} becomes the first word of the service name, such as "Bridal".

servicesCustomNote.title: Custom & repairs note (while bridal is on the waitlist)
servicesCustomNote.description: Under the custom & repairs description when that service is still open. {reopens} becomes the reopening time from Site Settings.
servicesCustomNote.default: Small repairs are open now. Larger construction and restoration projects reopen in {reopens}, and you can join the waitlist today.

servicesWhatIDo.title: Heading over the list of services

servicesTimeline.title: Label before the typical timeline
servicesTimeline.description: Shown before each service's typical timeline.

servicesGuides.title: Heading over the guide links
servicesGuides.description: Under each service that has guides. Pick which guides appear on each Service document.

servicesWorkedOn.title: Heading over the designers list
servicesWorkedOn.description: Shown under a service when its Service document lists designers or brands you've worked on.

servicesGuidesFor.title: Read aloud: the guide links
servicesGuidesFor.description: {service} becomes the service name in small letters.

servicesPartyHeading.title: Bridal party: heading
servicesPartyHeading.description: The block at the end of the bridal section. Its button uses "Send a bridal party request" under Buttons.
servicesPartyHeading.default: Bridal party & mother of the bride

servicesPartyBody.title: Bridal party: text
servicesPartyBody.default: Bridesmaids, mothers, flower girls: one point of contact, one pickup day. Open now, separate from the bridal waitlist.

portfolioEmpty.title: When a filter has no pieces
portfolioEmpty.default: No items in this category yet.

portfolioCaseStudy.title: Link on a photo to its case study

portfolioCountOne.title: Read aloud after filtering: one piece

portfolioCountMany.title: Read aloud after filtering: several pieces
portfolioCountMany.description: {count} becomes how many pieces are showing.

portfolioClose.title: Read aloud: close the enlarged photo

portfolioFeaturedRegion.title: Read aloud: the featured before and after

caseBreadcrumb.title: Case study: link back to the portfolio
caseBreadcrumb.description: Above the title of each case study page.

caseBreadcrumbNav.title: Case study: read aloud for that link

caseSliderLabel.title: Case study: label over the before and after

caseWeeks.title: Case study facts: number of weeks

caseWhatWasDone.title: Case study: heading over the alterations

caseHeroRegion.title: Case study: read aloud for the top section

sliderBefore.title: "Before" tag
sliderBefore.description: On the before and after slider on the portfolio page, case studies and care cards.

sliderUploadHint.title: Reminder when both photos are missing
sliderUploadHint.default: Upload photos in Studio → Portfolio Page

sliderValue.title: Read aloud: where the handle is
sliderValue.description: {before} and {after} become how much of each photo is showing, out of 100.

sliderBeforeAlt.title: Before photo description
sliderBeforeAlt.description: Read by screen readers when the before photo has no alt text of its own.

aboutHeroAlt.title: Top photo description
aboutHeroAlt.description: Read by screen readers only when the top photo on the About Page document has no alt text of its own. {name} becomes your name from Site Settings.

landingClosing.title: Landing pages: closing line
landingClosing.description: The last line on the landing pages, such as the bridal party page. {link} becomes the link below.
landingClosing.default: {link} and I will reply with an honest answer.

landingLink.title: Landing pages: link to the contact form

landingHeroRegion.title: Landing pages: read aloud for the top section

policiesEyebrow.title: Policies: small line above the heading

policiesHeading.title: Policies: heading when none is set
policiesHeading.description: Used when the Policies document has no heading of its own.

policiesEmpty.title: Policies: before any are written
policiesEmpty.description: Shown when the Policies document has no sections yet. {link} becomes the link below.
policiesEmpty.default: Policies are being written. In the meantime, ask me anything through the {link}.

policiesClosing.title: Policies: closing line
policiesClosing.default: Questions about any of this? {link} and I will answer plainly.

policiesLink.title: Policies: link in the closing line

policiesHeroRegion.title: Policies: read aloud for the top section

policiesDetailsRegion.title: Policies: read aloud for the policy sections

notFoundBody.title: Line under the heading
notFoundBody.default: The link may have moved or no longer exists. Let’s get you back to the right place.

notFoundHome.title: Link to the home page
notFoundHome.description: The other links use the Menu words under "Header and menu".
